EPS for Alphabet Inc. (GOOGL) Expected At $11.01 Posted by Louis Casey on January 6, 2019 at 6:01 am
Analysts expect Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOGL) to report $11.01 $1.31 EPS change or 13.51 % from last quarter’s $9.7 EPS. GOOGL’s profit would be $7.62 billion giving it 24.48 P/E if the $11.01 EPS is correct. After having $13.06 EPS previously, Alphabet Inc.’s analysts see -15.70 % EPS growth. The stock increased 5.13% or $52.6 $1078.07. About 2.30 million shares traded or 5.06% up from the average. Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOGL) has risen 0.82% uptrending. It has outperformed by 0.82% the S&P500. Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOGL) Ratings Coverage
